say:3:1210328001:1.text: Hey, this is where we came to catch the damedangler.
say:3:1210328001:1.source_cn: 咦，这里……这是我们来钓冥湾美人的地方呀！
say:3:1210328001:1.male: Hey, this is where we came to catch the damedangler.
say:3:1210328001:1.female: Hey, this is where we came to catch the damedangler.

say:4:1210328002:1.text: That's right. This is where the Whispers get their lumber.
say:4:1210328002:1.source_cn: 没错，这是血薇帮砍树取木材的地方。

say:5:1210328003:1.text: This place is dangerous! If you knew that the Whispers were stationed nearby, why did you tell us to come here and fish?
say:5:1210328003:1.source_cn: 但是，但是，这里很危险！明明血薇帮就在这附近驻扎，你还...

say:6:1210328004:1.text: I had no choice. If you wanted to find a damedangler at Blackwood Loch, you either had to go from the beach where I found you or go from Rustport's northwest gate.
say:6:1210328004:1.source_cn: 我也没辙！去黑木湖钓冥湾美人，要么从我捞到你们的沙滩走...

say:7:1210328005:1.text: No matter which route you take, there'll be Whispers guarding the place. At least this one had fewer guards. Don't blame me for getting caught last time.
say:7:1210328005:1.source_cn: 不管哪边，都有血薇帮把守着。上面这条路防守还稀疏点，怎...

choice_prompt:8:1210328005.text: No matter which route you take, there'll be Whispers guarding the place. At least this one had fewer guards. Don't blame me for getting caught last time.
choice_prompt:8:1210328005.source_cn: 不管哪边，都有血薇帮把守着。上面这条路防守还稀疏点，怎么能怪我指错了路？

say:9:1210328007:1.text: Alright, we can talk about that later.

say:11:1210328008:1.text: Why do the Whispers need so much wood?
say:11:1210328008:1.source_cn: 他们……血薇帮砍这么多木头干什么？

say:12:1210328009:1.text: I hear it's to build a ship big enough to take on the Immortal from the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:12:1210328009:1.source_cn: 听说是为了造一艘又大又好，能正面迎击死潮舰队不死号的大船。

say:13:1210328010:1.text: The Dead Tide Fleet is an infamous group of Graveborn pirates. The Immortal is their flagship, a terrifying ship as black as the deepest abyss.
say:13:1210328010:1.source_cn: 死潮舰队嘛，就是我之前提起过的那帮亡灵海盗。不死号是死...

say:14:1210328011:1.text: The Whispers are also forcing people to dig up rocks. Do ships need rocks?
say:14:1210328011:1.source_cn: 但是，血薇帮好像还在强迫劳工挖石头。造船也需要石头……？

say:15:1210328012:1.text: Rocks? Maybe they want to put catapults on the ship.
say:15:1210328012:1.source_cn: 压舱石？也没准他们要在船上装投石车。

choice_prompt:16:1210328012.text: Rocks? Maybe they want to put catapults on the ship.
choice_prompt:16:1210328012.source_cn: 压舱石？也没准他们要在船上装投石车。

say:17:1210328013:1.text: Let's not worry about what the Whispers are up to for now. Where are we going?
say:17:1210328013:1.source_cn: 先别管血薇帮了，我们现在要去哪里呢？

say:18:1210328014:1.text: They think we're spies for the Water Wights. We can't go back to Rustport.
say:18:1210328014:1.source_cn: 血薇帮把我们当成水鬼的间谍，锈锚港肯定是回不去了，那里...

choice_prompt:19:1210328014.text: They think we're spies for the Water Wights. We can't go back to Rustport.
choice_prompt:19:1210328014.source_cn: 血薇帮把我们当成水鬼的间谍，锈锚港肯定是回不去了，那里是他们的地盘。

say:20:1210328015:1.text: I'm glad you trust me. I do know a way to get you all out of here, but it passes by the Whispers' shipyard. What do you think?
say:20:1210328015:1.source_cn: 真高兴你们这么信任我。当然，我的确知道一条路可以送你们...

say:21:1210328016:1.text: With the magister here, Chippy and Hammie aren't afraid of anything!
say:21:1210328016:1.source_cn: 有主人在，满满和漫漫什么都不怕！
say:21:1210328016:1.male: With the magister here, Chippy and Hammie aren't afraid of anything!
say:21:1210328016:1.female: With the magister here, Chippy and Hammie aren't afraid of anything!

say:22:1210328017:1.text: Not bad, little guy! You're braver than you look.
say:22:1210328017:1.source_cn: 不错嘛，小家伙，挺有勇气！

say:23:1210328018:1.text: Alright, passengers! It's time to leave this place.
say:23:1210328018:1.source_cn: 辛巴达荣幸之至，走吧，我的船客们！

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 靠我们的万事通先生了

say:25:1210328006:1.text: You know it's always better to thank someone with gold. That's what I hear.
say:25:1210328006:1.source_cn: 要是能用金子做谢礼就更好了，<male>兄弟</mal...
say:25:1210328006:1.male: You know it's always better to thank someone with gold. That's what I hear.
say:25:1210328006:1.female: You know it's always better to thank someone with gold. That's what I hear.

choice:8:1:2.text: Once again, thanks for helping us.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 再次向你表示诚挚的谢意
choice:8:1:2.male: Once again, thanks for helping us.
choice:8:1:2.female: Once again, thanks for helping us.
